title: NHKマイルCの後に・さらに高みへ

text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki performs incredibly well at the NHK Mile Cup.
The audience is utterly captivated by her miracle. The younger student's depression and anger begin to lift as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki wants to inspire people even more. To do so, she wants to enter the Mile Championship—the race where the autumn queen of the mile is decided and where she'll also have to face senior-year racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the next race on our schedule is the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our race through the summer toward the Mile Championship and the strong opponents waiting there begins now!
